Good Morning Mohammed,

Yes, this apartment is available for a 4-month stay.

Regarding the rate, we will update you by tomorrow, Saturday, 29th August, with the 4-month rental price.

If you would also like to view the apartment, we can arrange a viewing for you tomorrow. Our viewing timings are from 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM.

Please let us know your preferred time, and we will arrange the viewing accordingly.

Thank you, and we look forward to hearing from you.
